title: galium boreale subsp. incurvatum
intro: Galium boreale subsp. incurvatum, commonly known as an alpine bedstraw or a narrow-leaved bedstraw, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Galium boreale subsp. incurvatum include its ability to treat digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
